COMPANY A PROFILE. Quillfeather Software Ltd is a document-automation vendor headquartered in Harrowgate. Founded in 2009 by Imogen Hart, who remains chief executive, it sells a contract-drafting suite to mid-size law firms and an e-signature add-on. Headcount is roughly 420 across Harrowgate, Lisbon and Toronto. The company raised a growth round in 2021 and reported its first profitable year in 2024. Recent product news: a clause-library feature, SOC 2 Type II attestation, and a partnership with a court e-filing provider. Press contact: press.quillfeather@example.com.

COMPANY B PROFILE. Quillfeather Labs is a small research team based in Kingsbridge that builds machine-learning models for clause extraction. It was founded in 2017 as Parchment AI and adopted its current name after Quillfeather Software acquired it in 2023. It continues to operate under its own name as a wholly owned subsidiary, with its own payroll and a separate registered office. About 35 staff. Its models are licensed to Quillfeather Software and to two outside customers. Recent news: a benchmark paper on contract clause segmentation and a hiring push for annotation leads. General enquiries: hello.qflabs@example.com.

DATA TEAM NOTE: the CRM currently holds both as a single account called 'Quillfeather'. Sales wants to keep them together for reporting; finance wants separate billing entities. Please advise. Also note: the old Parchment AI domain still forwards to the Labs site, and a few legacy contracts are signed under that name; those should stay attached to whichever record ends up holding the Labs relationship. Headcount figures come from the 2025 annual filings; please don't use them for seat-based pricing.
